_comments: Categories for the Sales API surface. A category is how a human or an agent browsing the
operation catalog finds the right operation — 'Sales' alone would eventually be a bag of a dozen.
FIXED UUIDs rather than generated ones, for the same reason orders fixes its own: these are
referenced by @lookup from the operation rows, so a stable ID means a re-push against a rebuilt
database resolves to the SAME category instead of quietly creating a duplicate. Given this repo
rebuilds from zero routinely, a generated ID here would produce a new category on every rebuild.

fields.Name: Deal Lifecycle
fields.Description: Compose, save and close deals. These are the operations that write a deal and everything hanging off it as one transaction — which is what makes browser-side deal entry possible at all, since line and schedule collections are transient properties on the server entity and cannot cross the entity-save boundary as scalars.
